versions.changelog:
- Fixed display issues with special characters and emoji throughout documentation and metadata.
- Updated documentation with improved formatting and clearer instructions.
- Added a "Plutus Pro" upgrade section, including purchase and install steps.
- Incremented version from 1.0.1 to 1.0.4 for clarity and alignment with latest release.
Fix: complete rewrite — skill was uploaded as empty YAML stub with no code

Initial release of Plutus — God of Wealth.

- Parse receipts and expense descriptions into categorized spreadsheets.
- Accepts raw text, lists, or CSVs of transactions as input.
- Generates clean expense reports with automatic category assignment.
- Provides totals by category, monthly spending trends, and budget vs actual comparisons.
- Supports use cases for personal finance, freelancers, and small businesses.
